theme: Young investor / first-timer: starting early, small amounts, ₹500/month
headline: Start Investing Today With Just Five Hundred
body: Beginning early with modest amounts builds wealth over time through consistent investing habits and market exposure.
caption: Your journey to wealth creation starts with a single step, no matter the amount. Small investments made regularly can grow substantially over decades. Start today, stay consistent, benefit tomorrow. #StartSmall #InvestEarly #WealthBuilding #ConsistentInvesting #YoungInvestor
